name: Starter Cue
note: The friendly rookie cue: a cream maple shaft with four slim sky-blue points edged in white and small white diamonds; OpenAI forearm (sky-blue gloss with white points and a white diamond) and butt (a sunny yellow knurled grip, a white sleeve with blue points and a little 8-ball emblem); a silver collar, a glowing blue ring, a black end.

forearm.prompt: Glossy sky-blue lacquer (#3B9BFF) with long slim white points (#F6F4EE) pointing left from the right edge, each edged with a thin pale line, and a small white diamond inlay between them on the middle row. Clean, simple, friendly. No text. The two thin strips at the far left are the joint collar: paint them plain flat silver grey (#B8BCC2).

butt.prompt: Left thin strip (the ring): plain flat dark grey (#101014). The wrap (from the ring to the next zone line): a sunny yellow rubber grip (#FFC928) with a fine raised diamond knurl pattern. The butt sleeve (between the two zone lines on the right): glossy white (#F6F4EE) with sky-blue points (#3B9BFF) reaching in from the left edge and one small pool 8-ball emblem (a black ball with a white circle holding a black number 8) on the middle row. The very thin strip at the far right: plain black.

Trail.Note: The white wisp tinted blue (Config.Effects style row).

Pocket.Note: The default gust in the ball's colour.
